extracted.name: Slow Cooker Baked Beans Using Canned Beans
extracted.description: These slow cooker baked beans with canned beans, ham, bell pepper, and onion are simmered in barbecue sauce and brown sugar for a versatile side dish.
ingredient_lines: 3 (14.5 ounce) cans great Northern beans, drained and rinsed
instruction_lines: Mix together barbecue sauce, ketchup, brown sugar, and mustard in a 4-quart slow cooker until smooth. Stir in beans, bell pepper, onion, and ham until well combined.
Cook on Low until thickened, 8 to 12 hours.
